completionType.description: How would you like Jasper to optimize your output? With quality, Jasper will take more time to generate the highest quality output possible. With performance, Jasper will prioritize generating outputs faster.

urls.description: An optional list of URLs for Jasper to scrape during generation to use as context. Max of 3 per request. If nothing is provided, Jasper will automatically detect URLs in the request inputs to use as context for the generation.

webSearch.description: Optional parameters for further customizing the behavior of the webSearch add-on.

maxResults.description: The number of search results to use for additional context when generating a response

searchQuery.description: A query to override the default behavior for how Jasper searches the web. If nothing is provided, Jasper will automatically define an appropriate query based on the inputs supplied.

siteBlockList.description: An optional list of domains for Jasper to omit from the search results. For example, providing mycompetor.com will filter out results returned with that domain and it’s subdomains, such as blog.mycompetitor.com. If nothing is provided, all search results will be used for the generation.

audienceId.description: Default Audience ID, e.g. `aud_...`. Pass `null` to clear. This sets the primary audience and leaves any additional audiences chosen in the app in place.

audienceIds.description: Default audience selection, with a primary audience and any secondary audiences. Replaces the full selection; pass `null` to clear. Takes precedence over `audienceId` when both are sent.

secondary.description: Secondary audience IDs included alongside the primary audience. At most 24.

knowledgeIds.description: Knowledge IDs (`kno_*`) to attach to the project. Replaces the existing set of knowledge attachments; pass an empty array to clear them. Non-knowledge attachments are not affected.

jasper_new_audience_trigger.description: Runs for each new audience in Jasper. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

jasper_new_or_updated_audience_trigger.description: Runs for each audience added or changed in Jasper. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

jasper_new_or_updated_task_trigger.description: Runs for each task added or changed in Jasper. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
